method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: Eeling 为自己来得晚了、并为 Hattie 所经历的一切向她道歉。
facts.anchor: I should have said this sooner, but I’m very sorry.

facts.fact: Eeling 查证后仍不清楚 Tommy 是如何挣脱腿铐的，猜测他走私了开锁的东西。
facts.anchor: it’s still not clear how he got free of his leg shackles

facts.fact: Eeling 说 Tommy 是从桥上跳下才没被立刻抓住，他闯入了下游一处待售房屋。
facts.anchor: if he hadn’t jumped from the bridge.

facts.fact: Eeling 说 Tommy 藏起车主的汽车、改骑山地车，把警方误导了数日。
facts.anchor: how he hid the owner’s car, then took a mountain bike instead

facts.fact: 逃跑当天 Detective Ramsby 打电话给 Hattie，说出了事、警察正赶来保护她。
facts.anchor: Detective Ramsby had sounded very strange

facts.fact: 一天之内 Leah 和 Dustin 都躲藏起来，第二天 Hattie 埋葬了丈夫 Ed。
facts.anchor: Within a day both Leah and Dustin had gone into hiding. The day after that Hattie buried her husband.

facts.fact: Hattie 说葬礼上约有十二名警察藏在各处，有的还伪装成悼念者。
facts.anchor: About a dozen hidden all over.

facts.fact: Hattie 说 Tommy 小时候最爱和 Ed 玩捉迷藏，而且一直很擅长躲藏。
facts.anchor: When he was small Tommy’s favorite game was hide-and-seek.

facts.fact: Hattie 指出已过八年、相隔五百多英里，她不喜欢那只猫头鹰；Eeling 问什么猫头鹰，猫头鹰随即消失。
facts.anchor: eight years and over five hundred miles in between
